displayName.ja: 【電磁鉄槌】 摸守　つくも

profile.ja:
五車学園の学生対魔忍。
苦無や手裏剣などを自由自在に操る“磁遁の術”を用いる。
おしゃべりで落ち着きがない好奇心旺盛な性格だが、入学以前の経歴が存在しないミステリアスな生徒。
その正体は学生たちの訓練用木人に宿った付喪神で、若き対魔忍たちの汗と涙、思念などが依り集まって具現化した存在である。
磁遁は木人であった頃のカラクリを利用して強い磁界を作り出し、道具を操作するというもの。
その力を使えば巨大な戦鎚も自在に操り、質量を活かした強烈な打撃を叩き込むことができる。
木人時代にインストールされていた訓練プログラムを応用し、重武器での近接戦闘に特化した形態である。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin student at Gosha Academy, utilizing the "magnetic evasion technique" to freely manipulate items like shuriken. She has a talkative and curious personality, but her history before enrolling in the academy is shrouded in mystery. Her true identity is that of a tsukumogami, a spirit that inhabits a training dummy used by students, born from the sweat, tears, and thoughts of young Taimanin. The magnetic evasion technique utilizes the mechanical workings of the training dummy to create a strong magnetic field, allowing her to manipulate tools within its range. With this power, she can even wield a massive war hammer with ease, delivering powerful blows. By applying the training programs installed in her during her time as a training dummy, she has developed a form specialized in close combat with heavy weapons.

text.ja: どーん！　スペシャル鉄槌だよ〜！　どう？　おっきいでしょ。これでもっともっと、あなたの役に立っちゃうからね、ね
text.en: Ta-da! It's my special iron mallet! What do you think? It's big, right? I think it'll come in handy for you, so I'll let you use it, okay?

text.ja: この新しい武器。電磁鉄槌、っていうんだよ。わたしの磁遁の術で、こうやってぶんぶん、ぶんぶん、ぶんぶんぶんぶん…………ふぇ〜、目が回っちゃったよ
text.en: This new weapon of mine is called an electromagnetic iron mallet. With my magnetic evasion technique, I can use it like this - bun bun, bun bun, bun bun bun bun... Whoa, I'm getting dizzy.

text.ja: 重くないのかって？　へへーん、磁遁を使えば、こんなの軽々なんだよ。あなたも持ってみる？　遠慮しないでほら、ほら
text.en: Isn't it heavy? Ha ha, not for me, thanks to my magnetic evasion technique. Want to try holding it? Go ahead, don't be shy.

text.ja: わたし、こう見えてけっこう頑丈なんだよ。木人（もくじん）の時は、たくさん叩かれても大丈夫だったからね。でも、大切に扱われると、やっぱり嬉しいね
text.en: I'm actually pretty sturdy, you know. When I was a training dummy, I could withstand a lot of punishment. But it's still nice to be treated with care, isn't it?

text.ja: 友達や先生たちを観察するのが、とっても楽しいんだ。ここではあなたのことを、いっぱい観察してるよ。気づいたこと？　うーん、秘密かな
text.en: I love observing my friends and teachers. Here, I get to observe you all the time. Have you noticed anything about me? Hmm, it's a secret.

text.ja: 今日は裏庭のネコちゃんを抱っこしたんだ。かわいくって、感動、感動だよ。木人（もくじん）のとき、爪とぎされたけど、許しちゃうよ
text.en: Today, I got to hold a cat from the backyard. It was so cute, and I was really moved. When I was a training dummy, I used to get scratched by cats, but I forgive them.

text.ja: 学校の授業は楽しいよ。一番好きなのは、保健体育かな。自分の体のこと、もっともっと知りたいからね
text.en: I really enjoy school classes. My favorite subject is probably physical education. I want to learn more about my own body, after all.

text.ja: これでお餅をついたら、あんこ餅をたーくさん作れないかな？　うーん、考えてたらお腹が空いてきちゃったね、ね
text.en: If I make mochi now, I wonder if I could make a lot of red bean paste mochi... Hmm, just thinking about it is making me hungry.

text.ja: なんでかな、見られてるだけで、体が熱くなっちゃう……んっ、ふあぁっ、まるで触られてるみたい、あああんっ……！
text.en: Why is it that just being watched makes my body heat up... Nn, fuah, it's like I'm being touched or something... Ahh, it's just like that!

text.ja: あなたのチンポも、勃起しちゃってるね。もっとそばで見てもいい？　男の子の体って、不思議だね、ね……！
text.en: Your erection is quite noticeable, isn't it? May I take a closer look? The human body is so fascinating, don't you think?

text.ja: あっ、はぁぁんっ、んんっ……！　これで赤ちゃんができちゃうの……？　すごいね、人間って、神秘だね……！
text.en: Ah, haaaa... nnng...! Does this mean a baby will be born now? Humans are truly mysterious creatures, aren't they?
